title: Bounded ingress sharding and tenant leaky-bucket for trace hotpath stability
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: At high QPS we observe unbounded memory/CPU spikes in the tracing hotpath due to a shared ingress buffer and global admission gate. This causes p95/p99 latency regressions and OOM events for trace-ingest workers. Goal: Introduce bounded per-shard queues and a per-tenant leaky-bucket admission filter at ingest to cap CPU/allocations and provide predictable degradation rather than catastrophic spikes. Solution outline: 1) Shard ingress by a lightweight tenant hash to N ingress workers (configurable via runtime flag). 2) For each shard maintain a bounded ring buffer with backpressure metric export and a soft-fail policy (drop low-priority spans when full). 3) Implement per-tenant leaky-bucket token buckets with configurable burst and sustained rates exposed in the Console. 4) Add fast-path checks in the tracer SDK and gateway to early-drop non-exemplar spans for high-volume tenants. 5) Provide rollout plan with canary, gradual shard increase, and fallback to global admission if misconfigured.
acceptance_criteria: No OOMs observed on trace-ingest during 48h soak at 2x peak QPS of last incident
p95/p99 CPU & wall-clock on tracing hotpath reduced by >=30% in perf bench
Per-tenant burst and sustained metrics visible in Console; per-tenant drops countable
Canary rollout completed with ability to revert to previous gate within 5 minutes

decisions: Prefer server-side ingress controls over SDK changes to avoid mass client rollout.
Use bounded ring buffers per shard with soft-drop of low-priority spans; preserve exemplars and sampling flags.
Expose per-tenant configs in Console with conservative default caps to minimize customer impact.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: misconfigured caps could silently drop important traces. Mitigation: implement 'dry-run' mode emitting drop warnings but not dropping.
Risk: increased operational complexity with sharding. Mitigation: provide autoscaling and clear rollback steps; include healthchecks for shard balance.
Risk: tenant hash skew causing one shard to be hot. Mitigation: implement periodic remapping and power-of-two scaling for shards.
review_feedback: Priya Rao (PM): Please ensure Console UX surfaces 'dropped span' examples and link to customer runbook.
Elena Varga (Frontend): Need API for tenant list pagination for Console before exposing per-tenant controls.
SRE (Jordan Smith): Add circuit-breaker on shard-worker restart to avoid thundering herd during rollouts.
